definitions.explanation: not yet having been dealt with, processed, or treated

examples.japanese: {未処理|みしょり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{未処理|みしょり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}して→流す：01968_nagasu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You must not discharge untreated wastewater into the river.

examples.japanese: {未処理|みしょり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{案件|あんけん}→案件：13109_anken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三十件|さんじゅっけん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今日中|きょうじゅう}→今日中：19382_kyoujuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けたい→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: There are thirty unresolved cases remaining, so I want to get them done by today.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet) + ⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ (processing, treatment). The prefix ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ is productive and indicates something has not yet been done: ⟦{未完成|みかんせい}→未完成：13066_mikansei⟧ (unfinished), ⟦{未確認|みかくにん}→未確認：22493_mikakunin⟧ (unconfirmed), ⟦{未解決|みかいけつ}→未解決：17292_mikaiketsu⟧ (unsolved).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未処理|みしょり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧: unprocessed documents
- {未処理|みしょり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧: raw/unprocessed data
- {未処理|みしょり}⟦{排水|はいすい}→排水：11104_haisui⟧: untreated wastewater
- {未処理|みしょり}⟦{案件|あんけん}→案件：13109_anken⟧: unresolved cases
- {未処理|みしょり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{放置|ほうち}する→放置する：25382_houchisuru⟧: to leave unprocessed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{未解決|みかいけつ}→未解決：17292_mikaiketsu⟧: unsolved, unresolved — specifically for problems or cases that haven't been solved
- {処理済|しょりず}み: processed, handled — the opposite state, indicating completion
- ⟦{保留|ほりゅう}→保留：08364_horyuu⟧: pending, on hold — deliberately put aside for later decision
